title: PalWallet
tagline: PalWallet is an AI-powered crypto agent that seamlessly integrates intelligent automation with direct user control. It enables customizable transactions, chat-based commands, and dApp interactions through WalletConnect, offering a hybrid approach to blockchain operations.
description:
PalWallet is a next-generation AI-powered crypto agent that enhances blockchain interactions by blending automation with user-directed operations. Built on Coinbase AgentKit, it allows users to execute transactions, simulate operations, and manage assets through an intuitive AI interface. The integration with Autonome ensures decentralized hosting for secure and efficient AI agent deployment.

PalWallet supports hybrid interaction methods, enabling users to perform simple tasks via chat-based AI interactions while seamlessly handling more complex operations through direct dApp integration using WalletConnect. Operating on the Base Network, it provides an innovative solution for both casual and advanced crypto users.

With PalWallet, users gain a flexible and efficient way to interact with blockchain networks, bridging the gap between AI-driven automation and direct transaction execution.
how_its_made:
![image](https://2025-agents-palwallet.vercel.app/architecture.png)

- **Coinbase AgentKit**: AI agent framework used to handle blockchain operations.
  - Added a custom handler for transaction simulation mock and direct transaction execution via WalletConnect. This demonstrates a new architecture solution for AI-powered crypto agents.
- **Autonome**: Decentralized hosting platform for AI agents.
  - Successfully integrated the Autonome backend with a custom frontend, providing an intuitive user interface for seamless chatbot interaction.
- **Base Network**: The primary blockchain network used for transactions.
- **Hybrid Interaction Methods (dApps Fusion)**: Simple operations can be streamlined through **chat-based AI interactions**, but most users require **complex operations** to gain real benefits—such as integrating with new protocols or handling advanced scenarios. **This hybrid interaction system** enables both approaches, **bridging user needs with the capabilities of the crypto AI agent**.
